cluster.kubectl_note: the Kubernetes client built into oc, invoked as kubectl

entries.cmd: kubectl create job report --image=registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/ubi-minimal:latest -- sh -c 'echo report: 42 orders processed' >/dev/null; kubectl wait --for=condition=Complete job/report --timeout=180s >/dev/null; kubectl get jobs; kubectl get pods -l job-name=report
